description: This file defines FastAPI routes for cache management, including ping, delete, redis info, and flush operations, utilizing litellm cache components.

methods.name: _extract_cache_params
methods.description: Safely extracts and masks cache parameters for health check display.

methods.name: cache_ping
methods.description: Checks cache health by pinging Redis and performing a test cache add.

methods.name: cache_delete
methods.description: Deletes specified keys from the cache.

methods.name: _get_redis_client_info
methods.description: Retrieves Redis client list info, handling restricted environments gracefully.

methods.name: cache_redis_info
methods.description: Provides Redis server and client info for monitoring.

methods.name: cache_flushall
methods.description: Flushes all cache items if supported.
